tei:div.tei:p: "!#༄༅// sa nad rtsa 'bu'i bcos dang srung ba zab mo bzhugs pa'i dbu'o//

na mo ha ya grī wa kā la ye/ bla ma yi dam dbyer med spyan ras gzigs// rta mgrin nag po'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal nas// snyigs dus nag phyogs klu gnyan kha dar nas// gnyan nad lhog pa spun dgu me ltar 'bar// 'gro la phan phyir de nyid srung ba dang*// gso thabs man ngag 'thor ba bsdus te bkod// chos bdag srung mas bka' gnang byin gyis rlobs// gdon ni klu gnyan gdug pa'i kha rlangs te// ngo bo srin bu'i gzugs can skra rtse tsam// dbye ba me chu rlung sogs dkar nag dgu// nang rtags 'dar zhing zug med 'bur ru bud// rim pas skrangs shing ma lus bzod blag med// nang du song na skrangs med glo bur 'chi// de nas bcos pa'i thabs ni 'di lta ste// mi chen yul du pheb pa la// gser zho gang gi ja 'dren gtang*// zhes pa skyer pa zhu mkhan khu ba phor gang btung*// 'bu ru'i rtse la sbrang dang ka ra byugs// 'bu ru'i rgyab kyi sor ba bzhi rtsa'am// skrangs pa'i mtha' nas ram dang btsag dang ni// ba bla rnams kyi 'ja' yis rim bzhin bskor// de rgyab sgang pa khyi lud byugs pas bskor// ming chen yod na chang dang 'o mas sbrus// skrangs pa la ni 'jar byas shin tu phan/ khyung lnga'i khong sman gtang rgyu yod na bzang*// yang na gla rtsi chu la sbyar pa gtang*// rdzas sman med kyang sngags dang sngags chus thub// rang nyid bram ze 'jigs rung ba// smin ma sma ra dmar ser la// me yi tshwa tshwa 'phro bar sgoms// sngags chu khro chu khol ma sgoms// lhog pa lhog bdag 'khor dang bcas/ khro chu khol mas bsregs par sgoms// sngags btab sngags chu 'thung dang byugs// dud 'gro yin na sngags chu 'debs/ khong du btang bas phan pa yin// oṃ rakṣa rakṣa bye ma rakṣa sod/ dmar ya dmar ya nag po thum hril le bsad sod swā hā/ lhog ro bsha' dgos byung na/ rang nyid khyung nag 'jigs rung pa// rwa mchu sder mo sgro kun las// me lce rab 'bar tshwa tshwa 'phro// sngags chu khro chu khol ma yis// lhog pa lhog bdag bsregs par sgoms// sngags chu 'thung shing lag pa bkru// lhog ro la yang sngags chus bran// bsha' ba'i gri rnams thams cad sngags// gri de khyung gi mchu ru sgoms// lhog ro de ni sbrul du sgoms/

khyung gis sbrul ni zos par sgoms// de nas lhog ro bsha' byas nas// sha rnams khrag thig med par btso// de nas btsong dang za bar rung*// rnga rtse rwa rtse rmig pa dang*// mchin mtsher btso grod rnams la gnas pa'i phyir// bsregs na sa ni gtsang ba yin// dong du gal te sba na ni// de steng me ni 'bud par bya// dbus gtsang mkhas pas bdag la gdams// lag len yod cing nges shes gsungs// / yang ni gnyan dang lhog pa'i sngags// rang nyid lcags kyi phag rgod ni// shin tu 'jigs pa ri rab tsam// nad bdag thams cad za bar sgoms// sngags btab sngags chu blud par bya// 'jigs zing zing sod/ mer mer sod/ lhug lhug sod// de ni o rgyan gsung yin zab// / rang nyid lcags kyi phag rgod ni// nad dang nad bdag za bar sgoms// a rbad sod/ lhog pa sod/ pra ma sod/ sngags dang sngags chus lhog ro sos// lhog ro khur dang bsha' yang phod// bram ze phru gu'i man ngag yin// / rang nyid lcags kyi phag rgod ni// mgo gsum kha nas me lce 'bar// sna steng gser gyi bya khyung lding*// phag rgod ngar ngar ngur ngur byed// gnyan dang lhog pa za bar sgoms// oṃ dhar dhi sod/ o ro sod/ yo rgod sod/ 'bru zi sod/ nan gyi sod/ ra kyi sa tri sod/ me lhog sod/ chu lhog sod/ thum shig phaṭa swā hā/ brgya rtsa brgyad kyis gnyan rnams 'bros// stong tsho bzlas na gag pa dang*// lhog pa'i nad ni sos par byed// gag lhog gnyis la thengs bas chog /sngags chu 'thung zhing lag pa bkrus// lhog ro khur dang bsha' yang chog /rta mgrin nag po'i gdams ngag yin// ratna gling pa'i gter nas byon// / lhog sngags ci li dgu skor 'di// ngag bcad khri phrag gcig bzlas nas// lhog pa'i nad la sngags chu gtang*// skyer khu blud cing 'bu ru la// gong ltar 'ja' ris la sogs bya// lhog ro rgyud pa 'bud nas phan// nor srung srung skud sngags la btags// rta dril chu byil byung na yang*// skrang mtha' sgron shing dud pa 'am// med na sur nag dud pas sregs// sngags chu gtang zhing sngags mang btab// skyer pa'i mde'u mda' rtse la// mdel rtse tshon gang pa de na// rgyus pas dkris te zug tshod bzung*// zhag gsum lon nas skrangs pa la// mda' de brgyab la chu ser gtsag

/gzhan yang thab gnyan skrang pa'i rigs// sngags de sngags kha dros nas ni// thams cad kun la 'di yis phan// oṃ ci li sod/ tsa ma li sod/ tsa ti sod/ tsha ti sod/ chu ti sod/ 'bram ti sod/ 'brum ti ha ra sod/ lhog pa dkar nag gnyis kyi dbal sod/ lag len yod gsung slob dpon ni// sngags rgyud can gyi gdams ngag yin// / yang lhog pa bcos dang srung ba'i thabs// bya sla phan che'i gdams ngag yod// mi yi nor phyugs gang na la// lus kyi mgo mjug phu mchil btab// sngags chu khong du btang bas phan// dud 'gro'i sems can na dogs na// sngags chu blud pas mi na 'o// sha la sngags btab zos pa yis// sha yi rgyud nas mi 'gos so// oṃ me tri du bas sod/ oṃ me yam me yam sod/ mgo ge mgo ge sod/ thog thog dbal sod/ sngags de mang du bzlas par bya// de rnams sngags grangs nges pa med// / de nas lhog srung 'khor lo bshad// sngags 'di yi ge dbu can la// tsheg ni med pa phreng gcig bri/ khang rgan dud pa khol mo'i spu/ khol kha'i sa tshig gla rtsi rnams// rdzas yin de la byugs pa 'o// cung zad shog dril gseb tu blugs// rang sngags stong gis shog dril sngags// rten 'brel snying pos rab gnas bya// shog dril mjug nas yar la dril// phying pa dkar pos g.yogs byas la// skud pa sum sgril lung byas nas// rta nor mgul du btags pas srung*/ oṃgrigasunan/ kurunan/ tsirayasod/ gnyidayasod/ lhogalhogakhulpasod/ azhizhimalamalasodaswāhā/ 'changabapolalhogapa'iganod pasrungasashigarakṣarakṣa/ de ni lhog srung man ngag go /'di ltar man ngag du ma rnams// phyogs gcig bsdus pa'i dge ba 'dis// sems can thams cad bde gyur cig /nyes 'gal mchis na lha la bshags// chos 'phel zhes byas bskul byas nas// sngags pa rā ga a syas sbyar// maṅga laṃ/// /
